column4: Same camera and scale as the reference. She has jumped: head down and feet up, her body tipped almost upside down in mid fall, arms swept back and out, long orange hair and skirt flying upward, eyes wide open, falling straight down the frame. Full-body view of the same porcelain maid doll as in the reference sheet and the approved pose: same face, long orange hair, orange flower ornament with white center, black dress with white apron and ruffles, white boots, ball joints and wrist rings. Exactly two arms, two legs, two feet and five fingers per hand; no strings, no controller, no floor, no shadow. The entire background is one flat pure chroma green (#00B140) with nothing else in it; the figure has a clean closed outline against it. The whole figure fits the frame with a small margin.
